hooks.name: Rollcall: sync captures on session start
hooks.description: Indexes new screenshots (OCR) when a Kiro session starts and, if any are unfiled, asks the agent to file them and add events.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && n=$(ALBUM_MCP_FOLDERS="${ALBUM_MCP_FOLDERS:-$HOME/Pictures/Screenshots}" uv run -q album-mcp sync --limit 20 2>/dev/null | python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)["unfiled_total"])' 2>/dev/null) && [ "${n:-0}" -gt 0 ] && echo "Rollcall: ${n} captures are unfiled. When the user's request allows, offer to run the Rollcall accumulation and event workflows (see steering rollcall.md)." || true
